limitations: Development verification only; official evaluation has not run.
No synthesis or board verification performed.
implementation: TopModule reverses eight input bits using a continuous assignment; original ports are preserved, with no clock, reset, or added latency.
verification: Independent per-bit oracle checks all 256 binary inputs and five additional four-state/boundary cases with case inequality, fatal mismatch checks, and a bounded timeout.
static_review: Eight-bit input and output; each output bit is connected to input bit 7 minus its index. No storage or inferred latches. Initial RTL snapshot preserved unchanged.
